def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors={v for r in g for v in r}-{bg}

from collections import Counter

def components(grid, exclude=None):
    """4-connected same-color components, as (color, set of cells), skipping the given colors (e.g. background)."""
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    skip={exclude} if exclude is not None else set()
    seen=set()
    for si in range(H):
        for sj in range(W):
            if grid[si][sj] in skip or (si,sj) in seen: continue
            c=grid[si][sj]; stack=[(si,sj)]; comp=set()
            while stack:

                if p in seen or grid[p[0]][p[1]]!=c: continue
                seen.add(p); comp.add(p); i,j=p
                for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(i+di,j+dj)
                    if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W: stack.append(q)
            yield c,comp

def bbox(comp):
    """(top, bottom, left, right) of a set of (i,j) cells."""

    """Fill each hollow rect's interior: 2 if interior area is even AND it is the
    largest interior among same-color rects (ties count), else 7."""
    bg=background(grid)
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    rects=[]
    for c,comp in components(grid, exclude=bg):

        t,b,l,r=bbox(comp)
        rects.append((t,b,l,r,c,(b-t-1)*(r-l-1)))
    best={}
    for t,b,l,r,c,a in rects: best[c]=max(best.get(c,0),a)
    for t,b,l,r,c,a in rects:
        v=2 if (a>0 and a%2==0 and a==best[c]) else 7
        for i in range(t+1,b):
            for j in range(l+1,r):
                if grid[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=v
    return out
'''
